primary_hero_assets.description: Immediate continuation from S2-10 in the same apartment geography: Claire secures/carries the already-approved essential, phone retained, storm/city transition visible behind. Camera locked.

Claire at the apartment door opening into the same building hallway; motivated dark charcoal outer layer may be introduced on-screen over established wardrobe; corridor practical/access indicators begin synchronized change.
Long-axis corridor with Claire moving outward and no more than one or two anonymous residents cautiously appearing; multiple access indicators/doors change state in ordered sequence; no panic crowd.

Locked elevator interior with Claire and ordinary control panel; building selects/overrides toward lobby/ground route through diegetic indicator behavior. Interface remains practical, not holographic.

Building lobby with exterior rain through glass and dry interior; exit/access hardware changes state in a coordinated mechanically plausible sequence; prepared transition motif must inherit Scene 02 proof language.

Claire foreground at the building threshold facing a rain-dark Paris street; traffic and transit systems reorganize in a controlled sequence; deep semantic foreground/midground/background planes and restrained parallax.

Claire profile/over-shoulder toward ordinary municipal/transit display and distant civic/security activity; same prepared transition status appears across independent systems; controlled authority transfer, no invasion spectacle.

Long street composition with Claire moving with purpose into Paris, phone in hand, coordinated city behavior continuing behind; walking requires bounded generated continuation or a motivated cut between stable states.

alternate_state_policy.forbidden: Do not create alternate framings merely to manufacture camera movement or A/B oscillation.

generated_continuation_policy.required_for: real articulated actions such as securing/shouldering an essential, opening a door while moving through it, and sustained walking

animated_insert_policy.rule: Animated inserts are diegetic scene events and must remain physically registered to their housings/surfaces.

reuse_policy.scene01_scene02_canon: Use accepted/authorized continuity material as reference or traceable source-derived coverage only. Preserve identity, environment topology, palette and motion language.
reuse_policy.new_generation: Authorized only for the eight named Scene 03 hero roles and the explicitly limited matched states above. Do not generate dozens of exploratory images after the storyboard is established.

fx_policy.weather: coherent storm; rain exterior/window/doorway exposure only
fx_policy.camera: locked or near-locked; motivated bounded move only
